meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动回复 Linear 议题的每条评论，无需 @ 提及。每个议题的评论线程会变成一个独立的对话。
howto.when: 当有人在你配置的 Linear 团队议题下发表评论时触发。

say.text: 帮我回复 Linear 议题 ENG-123 的最新评论。
say.note: Claude 会自动找到该议题并回复。

say.text: 总结一下 Linear 团队 NAN 所有未关闭议题的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会遍历议题线程并生成摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically replies to every comment on Linear issues without needing an @-mention. Each issue's comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone comments on an issue in your configured Linear team.

say_en.text: Reply to the latest comment on Linear issue ENG-123.
say_en.note: Claude will find the issue and reply.

say_en.text: Summarize all open issues in the NAN team.
say_en.note: Claude will go through issue threads and generate a summary.
